findings.finding: The report header retained default seeds while the effective CLI batch used six.
findings.action: Fixed the generator to serialize effective seeds/maxSeconds. Regenerated report and captures; independent systems follow-up verified provenance. Original reviewer source labels are retained.

findings.finding: White effects were hard to see against the pale arena in initial prototype inspection.
findings.action: Added dark backing before the reviewed round; reviewed evidence uses that correction.

findings.finding: Actual damage must remain distinct from release or harmless impact.
findings.action: Hit crosses are driven only by damage events. Selected evidence includes a missed melee release and two empty ice impacts; captions and tests retain those distinctions.

findings.finding: Victim markers do not identify the attacker or uniquely attribute a projectile in a crowd.
findings.action: Retained as a visible limit and contrary case. Keep existing projectile trails and intersecting fights; attribution requires a separately scoped experiment.

findings.finding: Preparation detail is small and several symbols can overlap at arena scale.
findings.action: Present the crowded opening and enlargement/full-fight controls. Judge actual playback before enlarging or adding effects; sampled stills do not settle distraction or pacing.

findings.finding: The cues add little magical identity and do not establish improved initiative, emotional payoff or pacing.
findings.action: Recommend advancing B cautiously for consequence readability only. Preserve these independent qualifications; no further rating round or combat change.

findings.finding: General notes from the movement experiment appeared in the spell comparison, making the old A/B/C preference ambiguous.
findings.action: Scoped general notes to the active experiment, retaining all feedback in storage. Production browser regression verifies other-experiment notes stay stored but do not appear as spell feedback.
